# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Cryptography

Enforces that Microsoft Edge does not set up connections below TLS 1.2, even if a server offers it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| checkId | `INTUNE-BASE-128-DCryptography` |
| Source | ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, NIS2 art. 21(2)(h) — setting from CIS v3 Microsoft Edge L1 |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Cryptography.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Cryptography.json) |

> Common policy requires TLS 1.2 or higher for web and cloud services. The WinINet stack is already configured correctly (Internet Explorer Legacy), but Edge itself so far accepted whatever the server offered. Note: internal systems that only speak TLS 1.0/1.1 become unreachable as a result — which is exactly why this is a pilot policy.
